purpose: Positive-detection spatial coverage and temporal clustering only; not model evaluation or precision.

method.distance: Approximate local planar point-to-full-polyline distance with longitude adjusted by route mean latitude.
method.temporal_clustering: Per route, detections on consecutive calendar dates (date difference at most one day) are grouped as one sequence. This diagnoses temporal dependence and does not establish one physical fire.
method.label_policy: Positive detections only. No detections, missing observations, or dates without a hotspot are unknown, never negative labels.
